sources.title: 示例学习资料：Technology and Learning
sources.note: 离线演示用原创短文；非历年真题。

articles.title: Technology and Learning — Original
articles.body: Digital tools can facilitate learning by making information more accessible. Yet access alone does not guarantee understanding. Students still need to evaluate evidence and reflect on what they read. Technology is most useful when it supports, rather than replaces, independent thought.

articles.title: Beyond Access: Learning in a Digital Age
articles.body:
The rapid spread of digital tools has made information easier to obtain. Advocates argue that these tools can facilitate learning and reduce barriers to education. However, access to information should not be confused with a deeper understanding of it.

A student may collect hundreds of articles without carefully considering a single argument. Effective learning therefore calls for more than efficient searching. It requires learners to assess evidence, compare perspectives and question their own assumptions.

Digital technology can play a vital role in this process when it encourages reflection. Its educational value depends less on the volume of material it delivers than on the quality of thought it helps to develop. Learning outcomes reflect the quality of thought.

vocabulary.original_sentence: These tools can facilitate learning and reduce barriers to education.
vocabulary.sentence_translation: 这些工具能够促进学习并降低教育门槛。
vocabulary.uncommon_meaning: 指使某个过程更容易进行，而非直接完成该过程。
vocabulary.writing_value: 可用于论述技术、政策或合作的积极作用。

vocabulary.original_sentence: Students still need to evaluate evidence and reflect on what they read.
vocabulary.sentence_translation: 学生仍需评估证据并反思阅读内容。

vocabulary.original_sentence: Learning outcomes reflect the quality of thought.
vocabulary.sentence_translation: 学习成果反映思维的质量。
vocabulary.writing_value: 可用于说明结果反映某种内在质量。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the educational value of digital technology mainly depends on its ability to _____.

options.text: deliver the largest possible amount of information
remove the need to compare different perspectives

questions.explanation: 文章末段强调技术的教育价值取决于它能培养的思考质量，因此 C 正确。
questions.evidence: Its educational value depends less on the volume of material it delivers than on the quality of thought it helps to develop.

distractor_analysis.A: 与末段对信息量和思考质量的比较相反。
distractor_analysis.B: 原文强调独立思考，并非取代判断。
distractor_analysis.D: 第二段明确提出需要比较不同观点。

writing_expressions.context: 论述某种因素对社会、教育或个人发展的贡献。
writing_expressions.original_sentence: Digital technology can play a vital role in this process when it encourages reflection.
writing_expressions.essay_sentence: Critical thinking plays a vital role in preparing students for an increasingly complex world.
writing_expressions.translation: 批判性思维在帮助学生应对日益复杂的世界方面发挥着重要作用。
